CITED EXTRACTION: "Darth Nihilus Respect Thread" (Comic Vine blog, Silver2467, Apr 12 2011, 2 comments)
URL: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/profile/silver2467/blog/darth-nihilus-respect-thread/67844/ (read 2026-10-11). LEGENDS. The YouTube clips are KOTOR II cutscenes, timestamps only. The Katarr scans are images from the KOTOR comics/Legacy of the Sith (?): source issue not given = GAP.
- S: Visas (KOTOR II): "His power is great, and it comes from hunger. He is a wound in the Force, more presence than flesh, and in his wake, life dies..."
- F: drains the Miraluka world Katarr (scans; KOTOR II dialogue also states it)
- H/F: "Nihilus saps Traya's powers in a calculated double-cross" / "They turn on her and drain her Force powers." (KOTOR Campaign Guide)
- F: essence bound into his mask/armor: "Nihilus uses its power to displace his persona into his robes and armor" (KOTOR Campaign Guide)
- S: Tobin (KOTOR II): "He tore it from the mass shadows of Malachor, along with his fleet... He holds it together." Campaign Guide: "managed to resurrect one of the crushed battlecruisers from Malachor V" (the Ravager)
- F (LOSS): vs Exile + Visas: "When Nihilus tries feeding on the Jedi, his hunger is mysteriously repelled... Psychically starved by the effort, the Dark Lord falls to the Jedi" (KOTOR Campaign Guide). "Although Darth Nihilus managed to stun the Exile... The Sith Lord was no match for their combined might" (Complete SW Encyclopedia). Context: hard counter (the Exile is a wound too), and 2v1 plus the Exile's party in-game.
